Upper MARCHIONESS OF ABERDEEN
Lower LORD ABERDEEN
Lord Aberdeen, former Governor-
General of Canada and Governor of
Ireland, and the Marchioness of
Aberdeen, are in America for an
extended visit. Lord Aberdeen went
to America to attend the International Architectural Exposition in
New York. The Marchioness is
president of the International Council
of Women, comprising thirty-six
nations and having a membership of
81,000,000. She will attend the sixth
quinquennial convention of the
society, to be held in Washington.

JAIL FOR CONTEMPT OF COURT

label: vision_footnote
text: Mrs. Mary Belle Spencer, one of the best known women lawyers in America, is defending a man charged with burglary, openly accused the judge of prejudice. Hey client was acquitted, but after the trial was over she was sent to jail for contempt of court.
